obligations.summary: Banks must perform enhanced identification for agent transactions above KES 70,000.
obligations.sourceExcerpt: Banks shall perform enhanced customer identification for every agent transaction exceeding KES 70,000.

obligations.summary: Institutions must report suspicious agent transactions within 24 hours.
obligations.sourceExcerpt: Licensed institutions shall report suspicious agent transactions to the Financial Reporting Centre within twenty-four hours.

obligations.summary: Institutions must retain agent transaction records for seven years.
obligations.sourceExcerpt: Institutions shall retain agent transaction records for seven years from the date of the transaction.

obligations.summary: D-SIBs must maintain an LCR of at least 110 percent.
obligations.sourceExcerpt: Domestic systemically important banks shall maintain a Liquidity Coverage Ratio of at least 110 percent at all times.

obligations.summary: Treasury must calculate the LCR daily.
obligations.sourceExcerpt: The Treasury function shall calculate the ratio before the start of each business day.

obligations.summary: Banks must report an LCR breach within 24 hours.
obligations.sourceExcerpt: Any breach shall be reported to the Central Bank within twenty-four hours of identification.

obligations.summary: Payment service providers must encrypt customer data at rest.
obligations.sourceExcerpt: Payment service providers shall encrypt customer data at rest and shall retain access logs for a minimum of twelve months.

obligations.summary: Payment service providers must retain access logs for at least twelve months.
obligations.sourceExcerpt: Payment service providers shall encrypt customer data at rest and shall retain access logs for a minimum of twelve months.

obligations.summary: Institutions must not activate an agent before due diligence is complete.
obligations.sourceExcerpt: A licensed institution must not activate an agent before completing and documenting the required due diligence.

obligations.summary: The compliance officer must submit the activation report within five business days.
obligations.sourceExcerpt: The compliance officer shall submit the agent activation report to the regulator within five business days after approval.
